reviews.comment: Yes, it's easy, but if you value your mental health, I suggest you avoid her at all costs. If you are going to take this class, I suggest you ONLY talk to the TA, if it is still Katrina, she was actually accessible and helpful outside of class. Daigle is very rude. I watched her berate a student in front of the whole class for asking a question.

Class is a hybrid. Always attend lab once a week. Work is split up into three units, not a lot if you start early. Good grading. Wasn't sure about prof at beginning but enjoyed her class by the end. Lots of oral presentations.

Good luck ever getting help outside of class. I'm not being rude but you can tell she has very little production experience and relates everything to zoo animals. It's not a hard class but I honestly felt like a lot of what she taught was really not applicable in a production setting. Wouldn't reccomend unless you want to work at a zoo.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: To be honest, she's not a very good professor. I thought she was kinda sweet at first, but that changed very quickly when I would ask her certain questions and she would be incredibly blunt with it. She wouldn't tell us anything, and I have not received one email from her about important things. Her teaching is NOT my cup of tea.

I met with Professor Daigle for a project I had to do. Not only was she rude, but she belittled my future goals. The point of this project was to have a positive experience with a staff member that teaches classes you are interested in, and it was far from positive. I will never take a class she teaches. Honesty is great, but disrespect is not.

I definitely enjoyed this class, but there's a reason it fulfills the writing intensive requirement. The large semester-long project is incredibly time consuming, but will teach you about the scientific process and it serves as the class final. Tests become more short answer/essay format as the semester continues. Great experience; lots of work.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Daigle was very nice and helpful, and made for a very interesting class.  Beware that there this is not a blow off elective, very work intensive which I was not expecting.  You will do well in this class if you work hard enough for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: New to TAMU in 2016 from my understanding, very good prof though. You will have to conduct and experiment in this class and write papers and create a poster for it. As long as you attend class, take good notes, and PAY ATTENTION you should do just fine. Very understanding and readily available to help with and talk through things with her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES
